callees.name: _messages_to_anthropic
callees.pre_condition: messages is a non-empty list of message dicts, each with keys 'role' (non-empty string) and 'content' (string).
callees.post_condition: Returns a 2-tuple (system_text, anthropic_messages). system_text is a string containing the concatenated content of all system-role messages (empty string when no system-role messages are present). anthropic_messages is a list of message dicts with 'role' and 'content' keys, containing all non-system messages in their original input order.

callees.name: _should_inject_user_id
callees.pre_condition: base_url is a string representing the LLM API base URL.
callees.post_condition: Returns True when the base_url matches a configured host pattern for which user-identity metadata injection is enabled; returns False otherwise.

callees.name: _metadata_body
callees.post_condition: Returns a dict containing metadata key-value pairs for injection into the API request body.
